units: Moodi rig units (Moodi = 1.83 tall = 4 cm on the real bag); Blender Z-up armature space, the USD skeleton prim carries the Z-up -> Y-up turn, so these are applied to SceneKit bone nodes as is
layout: each frame: one row per bone = [tx, ty, tz, qx, qy, qz, qw, sx, sy, sz]

notes.Emerge: progress clip: frame = progress * 90 (0 = only the sprout shows, 1 = about to pop)
notes.Mouth_Emerge: progress clip, same frame = progress * 90; always sample it with Moodi's Emerge
notes.Strain: 2 frames, additive: frame 1 minus frame 0, weight = press spring (0..1+)
notes.Mouth_Pucker: 2 frames, additive: frame 1 minus frame 0, weight = press spring
notes.FallIn: 15 frames: lands at 35 % exposure and sinks to 0 % with a squash; mouth follows Mouth_Emerge at progress 0.35 * (1 - f/15)^2
notes.Peek: 36 frames, loop while the muffled K2/K3 lines play (sprout + leaves wiggle)
notes.Mouth_Pop: 24 frames: the opening snaps into a small dimple and wobbles
